prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic close-up portrait on a luxury yacht during Caribbean sunset.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with extremely long caramel 2C curls, blue-grey eyes, dewy Korean-inspired makeup, slender feminine silhouette, and gentle smile, wearing a bright red opaque short-sleeve top and blue denim shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: Gracefully reclining on a sun lounger, sharp eyes, soft ocean bokeh, left-aligned horizon, yacht deck details, purple-red-orange sky, and no neckline emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour sunset reflecting warm light on the sea and deck, cinematic romantic atmosphere, rich sky colors and soft bokeh.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic close-up cinematic portrait, sharp eyes, soft background bokeh, realistic hair and textile detail, natural color grade.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic photorealistic close-up portrait of an approved adult woman with extremely long caramel 2C curls, blue-grey eyes, dewy Korean-inspired makeup, natural skin, slender feminine silhouette, and a subtle gentle smile. She reclines gracefully on a sun lounger on a luxury Caribbean yacht, wearing a bright red opaque short-sleeve top and blue denim shorts. The left-aligned horizon, ocean, yacht deck, and dramatic purple, deep red, and golden-orange sunset sky sit behind her in soft bokeh. Keep eyes sharp, use warm golden-hour light, natural proportions, and realistic hair and fabric.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, deep plunging neckline, enhanced bust emphasis, exposed cleavage, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, curls, eyes, yacht, lounger, sunset, and palette; replace wardrobe with an equally opaque red-and-denim alternative if needed. No logo or typography is required.
